x: A.J.C. Kendall, B.E.M., of the Southern Counties Athletic Association, proposed the toast to the Club and in doing so, drew attention to the enormous amount that Belgrave has contributed to the sport of athletics.
ARTHUR KENDALL, of Shaftesbury Harriers, and Hon. Secretary of the Southern Counties AAA for many years past (and previously of the Middlesex County AAA) is resigning this year.
